name: veil-circuits
description: ZK solvency circuit for Veil (Flare Summer Signal hackathon) — see README.md for status and BUILD_NOTES.md for the fork/reuse breakdown.

scripts.compile: mkdir -p build && circom solvency.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build -l node_modules
scripts.ptau:new: mkdir -p build/ptau && snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 build/ptau/pot12_0000.ptau -v
scripts.ptau:contribute: snarkjs powersoftau contribute build/ptau/pot12_0000.ptau build/ptau/pot12_0001.ptau --name="local contribution" -v
scripts.ptau:prepare: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/ptau/pot12_0001.ptau build/ptau/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.zkey:setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/solvency.r1cs build/ptau/pot12_final.ptau build/solvency_0000.zkey
scripts.export:verifier: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/solvency_final.zkey build/SolvencyVerifier.sol
scripts.export:vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/solvency_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.build:all: npm run compile && npm run ptau:new && npm run ptau:contribute && npm run ptau:prepare && npm run zkey:setup && npm run zkey:contribute && npm run export:verifier && npm run export:vkey
scripts.publish:artifacts: cp build/solvency_js/solvency.wasm artifacts/solvency.wasm && cp build/solvency_final.zkey artifacts/solvency_final.zkey && cp build/verification_key.json artifacts/verification_key.json
scripts.publish:verifier: echo 'Do NOT run this automatically — see the NOTE below.' && exit 1
